clips.send: Someone who just got a high blood pressure reading sends this to their spouse: the anxiety of being sold medication for a number that might be measured wrong.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau got sidetracked on his own show and never finished talking about blood pressure that day. But he left one fact on the table first.

An article on arm positions during blood pressure checks was published, then quietly disappeared. His point: the standard arm position used at most checkups can read higher than your real number.

His comparison: it's like a mechanic pulling a spark plug to sell you a $2,000 repair you never needed. Look at the test, scare you, sell the fix.

Next time you're tested, ask whether your arm was positioned the way the research says it should be.
